notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Norritt do not have summoning sickness.
There is another creature on the battlefield.
easyPrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness
Norritt does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Norritt and another creature.
Activate Norritt's first ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.
